time_integrators.new_note: one new opt-in ID under D147 (N2 with (a)), named by its builder in a dated addition to section 10 before its first run; it refuses to run unless X2 is selected

energy_check.cap_source: today's registered value, stage 0's m5.energy_rtol_ars222 (the lead's ruling)

B_P.source: stage 0's section 0 parity caps (projective's criteria.absolute_caps); no gate cap inherited, gates reported as information

gain_threshold.status: proposed; the user's to confirm before any arm's readings are read

user_decisions_open: whether X2 stands in for branch X's exact booking

source.check_at_run_time: sha256 recomputed, refused on mismatch; digest, revision and record identity written to each run's inputs

H2.window_import: rule (b), re-based: R3's amounts and channel gates at the start as declared initial values at t = 0, the cue re-timed, ledgers from zero, horizon the window's length

fallback_ii.when: X2 refuses the control on a window
fallback_ii.then: that window rerun for both IDs with X2 off as a development instrument check; its rows leave dt*

full_runs.rows: R3's kept rows on each arm's grid

W0.build: validation/long_duration/worlds.w0 as M5 built it (registration_20261118.json m5 and w0)

readings.pass: completes with every row accepted by the engine's checks (X2 included) and within the budget at every row of the reading, cumulative from t = 0
readings.dt_star: the largest rung on the ID's ladder that passes, every finer rung passing too; 'none on the ladder' otherwise
readings.gain: dt*(new) / dt*(today); undefined where either is none
readings.H2_join: window rungs (below 1 ms) read on the window's rows; full-run rungs (1 ms and up) on R3's rows; both at 1 ms
also_reported: X2 record: counted steps, q median and distribution, held steps, max sum|a|/F

instrument.I1a: on each window, the control at k = 9 against rung 0's k = 9 within the readable floor; the control at k = 2 on WA against R3's kept rows within the floor
instrument.I1b: the new ID's finest arm against today's within the readable floor plus both estimated errors (H2 windows at k = 9; W0 at 0.125 ms)

rows.fr3plant-q1_eps_1e-1: control resume admitted; planted resume refused with 'does not hold its state's residual'
rows.cap-control-fr18-fig5net100-16: refused with 'exceeds the registration's cap at accepted step 1'

instrument.I4: the order function on synthetic sequences (rung 0's I1)

outcomes.gain_at_least_threshold: converged within budget at dt*, development, X2 on
outcomes.between_1_and_threshold: a bounded gain, what binds named
outcomes.at_most_1: no gain; the ID stays opt-in
outcomes.undefined: reported with the side that has no passing rung

prediction.S_gain: any gain is here: H2 past 71.4 ms, W0 past 5.18 ms
